acceptanceCriteria: A range over the bound returns a code naming the bound, never changes-git-unavailable.
changes-git-unavailable is returned only when Git cannot be run or the repository cannot be read.
The refusal returns without first spending the full timeout when the commit count is known up front.
Spec requirement(s) recorded with acceptance evidence.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1083 (2026-10-18), observed on main-c976d52 from the source checkout. corvint changes --from A --to B succeeds at 338 commits but refuses 786 and 1,680-5,267 commits with changes-git-unavailable after about 60 s, although Git works and A is an ancestor of B. Expected: a code naming the bound/timeout (e.g. changes-range-too-large with limit and commits), returned without spending the full timeout when the commit count is known; changes-git-unavailable only when Git cannot run or the repository cannot be read. Optionally document the bound or allow --max-commits/paging.
title: changes upgrade checklist: a wide build range is refused as changes-git-unavailable instead of naming the bound (issue #1083)
